title: Digital-arrest call (English), recorded
description: An AI scammer (a Gemini script-writer reacting to the decoy's actual words, voiced by Gemini text-to-speech, all fictional) phones the live decoy. Everything on the right, from the transcript to the confirmed UPI ID and bank account, was produced by the real pipeline during this call. Both voices are exactly what each side produced; the pauses between turns are shortened, and the measured reply delay is in the stats.

strain.paymentMethod: Bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS) or UPI transfer to a third-party commercial account
steps: Claim to be a law enforcement officer investigating an intercepted illegal parcel linked to the victim's Aadhaar.
Threaten immediate arrest and demand absolute secrecy under the guise of confidentiality.
Instruct the victim to send a refundable verification deposit to prove their innocence.
Provide bank and UPI details under commercial or personal names to receive the funds.
Impose a strict 30-minute deadline while ordering the victim to stay on the line until payment is confirmed.
redFlags: A caller claiming to be police or CBI demands money to prove your innocence.
The caller insists you keep the call strictly confidential and tell nobody.
You are given an urgent deadline and threatened with immediate arrest if you hang up.
scriptExcerpts: A parcel registered under your Aadhaar card has been intercepted at customs containing highly illegal items.
Case [CASE NUMBER] is registered with an arrest warrant. Stay on the line and tell nobody. This investigation is strictly confidential.
Transfer a refundable verification deposit of [AMOUNT] right now to our official ID [UPI ID].
